children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 8, following a slew of corporate developments, order win and earnings.
Share price Shiprocket added 3% after its Q1 consolidated losses narrowed to Rs 13.7 crore Vs loss of Rs 18 crore and revenue jumps 33.8% to Rs 592.1 crore Vs Rs 442.5 crore, YoY.
Behari Lal Engineering shares fell nearly 2% despite reporting 24.5% jump in its Q1 profit to Rs 19.2 crore Vs Rs 15.4 crore and revenue increases 18% to Rs 151.7 crore Vs Rs 128.5 crore, YoY.

Share price of Arisinfra Solutions gained nearly 2% following the company through its subsidiary Arisunitern RE Solutions has secured an order from O2 Spaces, a partnership firm that is part of the Vaishnavi Residences Group, to provide DaaS (Developer-as-a-Service) services for Morning Mist, a residential apartment project in Whitefield, Bengaluru. The project has an estimated GDV of Rs 280 crore. The engagement provides an estimated material supply opportunity of over Rs 100 crore for Arisinfra.
Shares of HDFC Life Insurance Company added 1% after posting 17.8% jump in its new business premium at Rs 3,609 crore in the month of August, while YTD premium jumped 14.43% to Rs 15,570 crore.

Shares of Neuland Laboratories added 2% following board approved capital expenditure of Rs 126 crore towards the purchase of approximately 134 acres of land at Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. The company also has a right of first refusal to purchase an additional contiguous land parcel of approximately 66 acres at a later date, taking the potential aggregate land parcel at the said location to approximately 200 acres. The land is proposed to be used for the company's future expansion.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: Shiprocket jumps 3% as Q1 loss narrows; Arisinfra Solutions gains 2% on order win
